item.title: Jesse Nurmi embraces change in return to London Knights from pros
item.description: Jesse Nurmi used the same word a lot to describe his return to the London Knights late last month. Different.

item.title: Police seek help finding two London teens missing since Jan. 16
item.description: The teens, aged 15 and 14, were last seen near Adelaide Street South and Maud Street in London’s south end.

item.title: Elgin, Oxford counties recognized as age-friendly communities
item.description: Elgin-St. Thomas and Oxford County are being celebrated by the province for being age-friendly communities.

item.title: Report to city council could advance free bus pass program for students
item.description: A proposed pilot would provide free transit passes to Grade 9 and 10 students at Clarke Road secondary school.

item.title: Canadale Nurseries begins final chapter, will close in 2027
item.description: The sprawling garden centre and nursery on Sunset Drive in St. Thomas began as an immigrant's dream.

item.title: Man who robbed London store emotional as he's sent to prison: 'I'm sorry'
item.description: Joshua Awcock’s apology for robbing a London convenience store was recognition that his crime was a direct link to needing help for his drug addictions.

item.title: Q+A: CAMI union leader reflects on 35 years at the plant
item.description: As he wraps up his tenure Friday, Mike Van Boekel reflects on layoffs, strikes and an uncertain future for the Ingersoll plant.

item.title: Another Armstrong helping Western women’s basketball reach new heights
item.description: Graduate guard Renée Armstrong has emerged as a key contributor for the surging Mustangs this season.

item.title: Man arrested in fatal Old East Village shooting: Police
item.description: Sunday’s fatal shooting marked London’s second homicide of 2026.

item.title: Former Woodstock mayor Trevor Birtch faces 3.5 to 6 years in prison
item.description: Sentencing arguments were heard Thursday after the former mayor was convicted of two counts of sexual assault.
